card.name: Phone number digits and 'for' groups
card.fires_on: Digits inside US phone numbers, especially the area code or first digit after an opening parenthesis. Also a word naming a group of people or an activity after 'for', such as arts or athletes.

modes.label: Phone number digits
modes.description: A digit inside a US phone number, often the first digit of the area code.

modes.label: Group or field nouns
modes.description: A noun naming a group or field right after a preposition like 'for' or 'children'.
